verdict.rationale: Conductor is a standalone Mac app for running coding agents in parallel, each with its own workspace, terminal and diff. Chat happens inside Conductor's own app. Nothing in the evidence shows an IDE extension or in-editor chat panel. The community-mentioned 'Open in...' menu only hands work off to external tools, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can chat with the coding assistant directly inside my IDE for contextual help
